publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Knowledge graph is an important part of artificial intelligence. In terms of resource management, knowledge graph can label and aggregate resources, so as to complete intelligent matching and rapid retrieval of resources. However, when we constructed knowledge graph of resource management, there were some phenomena, such as redundancy of entities, isolated entities and so on. So in the face of these problems, we propose a data cleaning method.Its implementation has four stages: In stage 1, we use NLP technology to detect and classify problematic data. In stage 2, for the single problematic entities, we make pattern statistics and design a relationship supplement method based on relationship reasoning and a new entities alignment method. In stage 3, we recursively supplement and align knowledge fragment sets formed by interconnection of multiple problematic entities. In stage 4, for these isolate knowledge fragment sets, we propose an alignment and fusion method based on multiple entity relationships. Finally, we conducted experiments on our knowledge graph to prove the accuracy and effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Analysis of Jiangsu Education Development Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: In the new era, the enforcement of the two-child and three-child policies has not only caused changes in the population structure, but also had a profound impact on the development of education. This paper reveals the development law of population change in Jiangsu Province through data mining, explores the spatial characteristics of the educated population in Jiangsu Province, analyzes the impact mechanism of population change on education, and puts forward relative policy suggestions based on statistical measurement. The results show that the people receiving elementary education and higher education in Jiangsu Province increased, while the people receiving vocational education decreased. From the standpoint of spatial distribution patterns, the education attainment of cities in Jiangsu Province is unevenly distributed. From the perspective of spatial autocorrelation, there is a strong positive correlation between the number of people receiving elementary education, a negative correlation between the number of people receiving higher education and a weak positive correlation between the number of people receiving vocational education in Jiangsu Province. From the perspective of regional differences, the regional difference in the population receiving higher education in Jiangsu Province is great difference, and the regional differences between the population receiving elementary and vocational education are small. Jiangsu Province should promote the supply of educational resources and accelerate the balanced development of the whole province in combination with its story.

articleTitle: A Random Smoothing Defense Method based on Attention Mechanism against Automatic Modulation Classifier Attack
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Although deep learning has been extensively studied in communication tasks such as wireless signal modulation recognition, as the research progresses, researchers have found that deep learning-based system models have security concerns that are dominated by adversarial sample attacks, adding carefully designed subtle additional perturbations to the input signal that may alter the output of the model classifier. The development of adversarial samples poses a great threat to the development of deep learning, and there have been many research results on defending against adversarial samples. However, many defense methods enhance the defense effect while causing serious impact on the normal performance of the system, this paper proposes a new defense method for adversarial sample attacks in signal modulation recognition: a random smoothing defense method based on attention mechanism. By adding adversarial samples to the input signal for retraining, the model is made to rely more on reliable robustness in decision.

articleTitle: Design of petrochemical power distribution and substation digital delivery system based on microservice architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Digital delivery and digital construction are important means for petrochemical enterprises to improve their management level and competitiveness. This paper introduces a design idea of a digital power distribution and transformation delivery system for petrochemical enterprises based on micro service architecture, and discusses the technical route from the perspectives of overall platform architecture, storage and management of multi- source data, three-dimensional lightweight modeling and three-dimensional configuration development, operation and maintenance management of petrochemical electrical equipment in the whole life cycle. The implementation of the system will help petrochemical enterprises comprehensively improve the operation and maintenance efficiency, equipment monitoring ability and equipment management and control mode, and finally achieve the effect of intelligent operation and maintenance of petrochemical enterprise.

Author Keywords: Life cycle operation and maintenance management

articleTitle: Interruption-driven resource competition defect model and testing methodology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Interrupt-driven embedded systems are widely used in various safety-critical fields such as military equipment and aerospace, and the resource competition problem brought by interrupts is one of the most prominent problems. The current research on various resource competition problems is rather fragmented and one-sided, and varies widely from field to field. In this paper, based on the accumulation of many years of testing experience in the laboratory, we statistically cover and analyze the resource competition problems found in hundreds of testing projects, identify and classify them, analyze the sources of defects, summarize the characteristics of defects, and defect patterns, and construct an interruption-driven resource competition defect model. Finally, combined with the analysis of typical examples, we provide a comprehensive summary of interruption conflict scenarios and test analysis methods, and can design precise and efficient concurrency analysis methods according to the characteristics of interruption-driven resource competition and domain context in a targeted manner. We have combined the existing method system and tool system, applied and analyzed in several software evaluation work, and the results show that the model system can effectively improve the detection effect of interruption-driven resource competition defects and increase the confidence of the evaluation results.

articleTitle: Fine-grained Sentiment Semantic Analysis and Matching of Music and Image
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Both music and images are rich in emotional information. This paper focuses on the fine-grained emotion semantic within and between acoustic and visual contents and establish the relevant matching model. Through three subjective evaluation experiments, we obtained the fine-grained emotion evaluation score of music and images in different modalities. Combined with the factor analysis method, the sentiment semantic association of image, music and the joint action of music and images are analyzed. Based on the joint emotion space of images and music, we proposed several cross-modal matching methods from the perspective of emotional consistency. Finally, the validation experiments show that the synchronous matching algorithm with the common factor distance and emotion distance discrimination has the best rating results of viewing experience. The research provides experimental data for the intelligent retrieval and production of music and image content, which lays the foundation for the automatic matching of audio-visual works.

articleTitle: Research on coupling system of unmanned helicopter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Unmanned helicopter is used in various fields and tasks with its advantages of low cost and strong survivability. This paper focuses on the application of unmanned helicopter logistics transportation, systematically analyzes the characteristics and modes of unmanned helicopter suspension system, and obtains the coupling system model of unmanned helicopter and suspension system by carefully deriving the dynamic model of unmanned helicopter and suspension system, and then carries out the research on flight dynamic modeling.

articleTitle: Space Fence - Space Target Signal Capture and its Algorithm Introduction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: As an important tool for space target surveillance, the electronic fence system has attracted wide attention as it monitors and catalogs space targets and forecasts possible collisions, which can protect normal human space activities. In the electronic fence system, the signal processing technology is one of the key technologies, and the superiority of the signal processing algorithm has an important impact on the performance of the system. Therefore, it is necessary to study the signal processing algorithm in the electronic fence system for space target surveillance.

articleTitle: Research on Ship Track Fusion Model based on Distributed Extended Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Radar and AIS (Automatic Identification System, AIS) are two types of safety navigational aids that ships must be equipped with. Due to the complementarity and redundancy of the data collected by the two, the fusion method of AIS and radar information can be used to improve the accuracy of the track. In view of the fact that the distributed Kalman filtering method that has emerged in recent years fails to consider the impact of ship speed changes on the fusion accuracy, this paper puts forward a ship track fusion model based on distributed extended Kalman filter. The correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method are illustrated through the analysis of evaluation indicators and experiments.

articleTitle: An Intrusion Detection Mothod based on Feature Selection and Binary Classification Grouped Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: The detection rate of the minority class is generally low because of the unbalanced distribution in the intrusion dataset. To improve the detection rate of the minority classes in the intrusion detection dataset, this paper proposes an intrusion detection method (GLM-IDS) based on the binary classification and ensemble learning method. It first selects the features that are important for the binary classification training based on the features importance method. To overcome the difficulty during the multi classification training which cannot give attention to the minority classes, this method transforms the multi classification to the binary classification problem and then performs binary classification training in groups to keep the balance of the minority classes in the training dataset. The final multi classification decision is computed from the multi binary classification results based on the ensemble learning method. The experiment of GLM-IDS is compared to other multi classification methods such as machine learning and deep learning models. The result shows the feasibility that this method improves the detection rate of the U2R and R2L which belong to the minority classes without reducing the detection performance of the majority classes.

articleTitle: Edge Computing Offloading Strategy for Fast Diagnosis of Image of Substation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Since devices of the Internet of Things in power transmission and transformation system do not have the function of accurate identification of defects in video images, it is difficult to meet the requirements of intelligent analysis of video images for online intelligent inspection of substation. Method of image rapid diagnosis for substation is proposed in this paper, heavy power task such as image recognition of the edge being offloaded, putting forward the task offloading model and decision mechanism, formulating the offloading scheduling strategy based on deep learning, proposing offline algorithm and online algorithm to solve the scheduling problem. Finally, the paper simulates the diagnosis of inspection image of substation, and gives the system energy consumption and calculation delay under different task offloading modes, which can meet the requirements of devices fault identification and diagnosis under scenario of substation video inspection.

articleTitle: Power Service Mapping Scheduling Method Based on Fusion of 5G and Time-Sensitive Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: 5G has low-latency, high-reliable connection capabilities, and wired time-sensitive networks (TSNs) can provide deterministic standards and specifications. The collaboration and integration of 5G and time-sensitive networks has become a hotspot for the expansion of the current smart grid field. In order to ensure the quality of service (QoS) of time-sensitive flows of power services such as distribution automation, dynamic protection of distribution network differences, and intelligent power distribution, it is currently the a difficult point. To solve this problem, this paper studies a dynamic QoS time-sensitive flow mapping scheduling scheme based on edge-assisted 5G TSN bridging network architecture. In order to manage network resources and dynamically program network configuration, this paper uses the method of Software Defined Network (SDN) to manage network resources, concentrate network functions on some network devices for processing, and provide different applications. QoS. In order to further meet the requirement of low latency, a two-stage online algorithm is proposed to solve the joint scheduling problem of 5G and TSN, and realize the waiting-free transmission of high-priority power services. The simulation results show that the algorithm designed in this paper can maximize the utilization of network resources while meeting the QoS request delay requirements.

articleTitle: Research on Gesture Recognition Based on F-S Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: In order to further improve the accuracy of gesture authentication, based on the traditional Frechet distance and Support Vector Machine (SVM), this paper proposes a two-level authentication algorithm that combines space trajectory similarity and feature classification, which is called the F-S algorithm. The method mainly uses the linear accelerometer data of the mobile phone to obtain the three-dimensional spatial trajectory of the gesture action in the mobile phone coordinate system after preprocessing, and then extracts the time domain features of the trajectory, and then uses the F-S secondary authentication algorithm to identify and authenticate the gesture. The experimental results showed that the false rejection rate FRR of the F-S algorithm in the gesture recognition process is 4.13%, and the false acceptance rate FAR is 1.26%.

articleTitle: Hybrid-driven Automated Testing Approach for Complex Process Equipment Software
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Automated testing is an approach to transforming human-driven testing behavior into automated machine execution, which can perform many tests that are difficult or impossible to achieve by manual testing. Due to complex business, tight coupling, strict timing, and a large amount of data exchange, many equipment software cannot be tested by manual testing. Developing dedicated test tools is costly, time-consuming, and requires advanced programming knowledge. That poses a significant challenge for testers with limited programming skills. To this end, we propose a hybrid-driven automated testing approach. We design and realize a test automation platform based on the ideas of data-driven and keyword-driven testing. We also design configuration rules and implement them in this platform. With this platform, testers only need to focus on business analysis and make simple configurations to conduct automated testing for complex process equipment software. There is no need to develop dedicated test tools or write test scripts, which reduces the technical threshold for automated testing. Application results indicate that our approach can perform more business scenarios than manual testing and physical testing. Compared with conventional automated testing approaches, ours does not require testers to have programming skills. It is simple to use, easy to maintain, and extensible.

articleTitle: Research on the software and algorithm part of road condition analysis based on helper intelligent sunglasses
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Modern visually impaired people are faced with travel difficulties and high prices of guide products, which bring a lot of inconvenience to the lives of visually impaired people. For the main users, research related functions according to the actual needs of visually impaired people. This work mainly focuses on the software and algorithm parts, and conducts research and practice based on the analysis of the basic conditions of the road to realize the realization of smart sunglasses. Smart mobility sunglasses mainly rely on deep neural network technology, collect basic road conditions through hardware systems (such as millimeter-wave radar, ultra-wide-angle cameras), and use convolutional neural networks and dynamic model training to establish a relatively complete road condition database. The multi-module algorithm is used to achieve the purpose of real-time monitoring of road conditions and dynamic feedback of road conditions, effectively ensuring the travel safety of visually impaired people, and optimizing the user's product experience. The software functions are mainly divided into recognition function, navigation function, and voice conversion function. The recognition function mainly includes intelligent judgment of basic road conditions and traffic signs, helping users to make correct judgments. In terms of software implementation, OpenCV and Tensorflow related content are mainly used for multi-target tracking and neural network establishment. A variety of algorithm calculations are used to initially establish the sunglasses model to ensure the real-time and reliability of the product.

articleTitle: A Secure Computing Offload Approach for Power Services Based on 5G Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: The integration of 5G and energy Internet has enriched the type of electric power business and improved the quality of electric power business bearing. The power business under the new situation puts forward higher requirements on the communication delay and data security of 5G network. A power multi-service computational offloading method with the assistance of data security transmission is proposed. First, the communication model, computational offloading model and security model under 5G edge computing scenario are constructed, followed by the establishment of computational offloading and resource allocation strategy optimization function for business requirements, and finally, an improved offloading algorithm based on quantum evolutionary algorithm is proposed to solve the problem. The simulation results show that the proposed service offloading method can reduce the total system overhead as much as possible while ensuring security, effectively improving the security problem and service delay optimization problem brought by the open 5G capability, and comparing with the offloading strategies proposed in two related works, the results prove that the proposed improved offloading algorithm based on quantum evolutionary algorithm can effectively reduce the system energy consumption and delay.

articleTitle: Comparison of HRRP-based satellite target identification methods
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: High Resolution Range Profile is to achieve high-resolution imaging of targets at the radial distance of radar line of sight, which can obtain rich target structure information and is easy to obtain and good in real time. Therefore, characterization of high-resolution one-dimensional distance image and study of target classification and recognition in combination with electromagnetic simulation technology are the key research contents of this paper. To address this idea, a satellite target recognition comparison is proposed to realise the feature extraction by principal component analysis of the 1D distance image data of satellite targets obtained by simulation using FEKO software, and to compare the recognition of different satellite data to verify the recognition effect of satellite targets under different classifiers.

articleTitle: Research of Face Image Preprocessing and Classification Based on Torch Module
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Accelerating the preprocessing of large batches of face images before training is one of the bottlenecks that limit its real-time application effect. This paper proposes a method for processing face images: by sharpening the image, processing its gray-scale and small moment waves, it processes background of face images, making them more identifiable. Then using torch technology, it can reduce face images in large batches and improve the efficiency of processing tens of thousands of images for deep learning-based classification processing. After the two steps, it processes and accelerates classification of face images for different applications, such as office private documents and police station private documents. Comparing with the traditional method, the speed is increased by 1/3 and the processing and classification accuracy is over 93%.

articleTitle: An Out-of-Order Packet Processing Algorithm of RoCE Based on Improved SACK
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: RoCE (RDMA over commodity Ethernet) combines the go-back-N retransmission mechanism, priority-based flow control (PFC) and congestion control (CC) algorithms to achieve the low latency, low CPU overhead and high bandwidth required by data center networks (DCN). However, when faced with scenarios such as multi-path and adaptive routing that may lead to out-of-order packets, RoCE is prone to serious throughput degradation. This paper proposes an improved Selective Acknowledgement (SACK) algorithm for RoCE (SACK-RoCE) to solve the above problem. The SACK-RoCE includes three mechanisms: packet trace, out-of-order packet detection, and lost packets retransmission. In simulation, we test the performance of the SACK-RoCE in both single flow and real-world flows environment. The SACK-RoCE improves the throughput by 7 times compared to RoCE and can almost keep the number of retransmission times consistent with the number of lost packets. As for real loads, the SACK-RoCE outperforms the improved RoCE NIC (IRN) by 12.05%∼22.32% on average FCT, tail FCT and average slowdown metrics. In addition, the SACK-RoCE adds only 315 bits of memory usage per link, which makes the algorithm easy to deploy.

articleTitle: Mobile Perimeter Guard System based on Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: In recent years, with the remarkable performance of CNN in the field of computer vision, various intelligent analysis tasks have been widely used in real world. At present, intelligent analysis tasks can be deployed both on GPU servers and on mobile terminals (e.g., smart phones, embedded boards). Compared with GPU server mode, mobile-terminal-based mode can not only greatly reduce the bandwidth, but also effectively reduce the calculation load of the server. More importantly, it can build a more stable intelligent analysis system. Based on the above considerations, a MobileNetSSD-based perimeter guard system is proposed and a series of performance evaluations are conducted in this paper. Through experimental evaluations, it is shown that the proposed perimeter guard system can be applied to the service of perimeter guard in a factory or a residential area.

articleTitle: Realization Technology of Spatial Constraint Message Oriented Middleware in CPS
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: In the current implementation of smart citys, Message Oriented Middleware are widely used to realize information exchange between heterogeneous systems. In the process of using the above message middleware, the provider and demander of the message express their interest in publishing and subscribing to the message in a specific topic, and publish and subscribe to the message on the predetermined topic, and do not involve the relevant processing of constraining the spatial scope of the two sides of the message interaction. However, the message middleware used in the smart city CPS system needs to process a large amount of data collected from the physical device in real time, so the use of message middleware that supports spatial scope constraints in the smart city CPS system can achieve accurate interaction control with the physical devices in the smart city space, and control the interaction and feedback range of each message data in a small range, thereby saving network bandwidth. This thesis This paper analyzes the operating mechanism and principle of the currently widely used message middleware. In the comparative analysis of various types of message middleware, it is found that the Kafka message middleware has a high performance in processing massive data and active data. Based on the Kafka message middleware, a spaceconstrained message middleware model is proposed, and the implementation technology of space constraints is further studied.

articleTitle: Partial Interference Alignment for Downlink Heterogeneous Network in the Medium SNR
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Interference alignment is a common method in the analysis of interference network capacity. By dividing the signal space into two parts in the transmitter, the expected signal and interference signal are distinguished. The traditional interference alignment can obtain the optimal solution only at high signal-to-noise ratio, and its performance decreases greatly at low and medium signal-to-noise ratio. This paper proposes a partial interference alignment scheme for the downlink transmission of heterogeneous networks under medium signal-to-noise ratio. Firstly, the downlink network interference model composed of macro cells and small cells is established; Secondly, according to the power constraint of the cell transmitter, the hard part interference alignment is proposed, which can adaptively select the transmission subspace and capture the tradeoff between the transmission dimension of small cell users and macro cell users; Then, the hard part interference alignment algorithm is further improved, that is, the soft part interference alignment. The desired signal and undesired signal are balanced at each client, and the receiving matrix is solved by iterative method. The experimental results show that the proposed partial interference alignment method can achieve better capacity under moderate SNR conditions, and the convergence of the iterative method is independent of SNR.

articleTitle: Shelf-life Quality Monitor of Postharvest Tomato Based on Visible/Near Infrared Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Visible and near infrared (Vis/NIR) spectroscopy combined with chemometrics was investigated for the fast determination of soluble solids content (SSC), pH and firmness of postharvest tomatoes during shelf-life. A total of 630 tomato fruit samples from 5 cultivars and 9 days shelf-life was selected for the analysis, 450 samples (90 for each variety and 50 for each day shelf-life) were selected as calibration set, whereas 180 samples (36 for each varietyand 20 for each dayshelf-life) for the validation set, Partial least squares (PLS) analysis was implemented for calibration of models with spectra preprocessed by Savitzky-Golay smoothing, Optimal factors were used as the inputs of least squares-support vector machine (LS-SVM) models with grid search technique and RBF kernel. All LS-SVM models outperformed PLS models. The correlation coefficient (r), RMSEP and bias in validation set by LS-SVM were 0.8676, 0.1192 and 0.0610 for SSC, 0.8587, 0.5067 and 0.0653 for pH, 0.8515, 1.0867 and 0.0516for firmness, respectively. The results indicated that Vis/NIR spectroscopy combined with LS-SVM could be successfully applied for the determination of SSC, pH and firmnessof postharvest tomatoes in shelf life. The results will be helpful for further analysis of using Vis/NIR spectroscopy to monitor horticultural product quality in shelf-life.

articleTitle: Driving mechanism of thermal environment based on Bayesian structural equation model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: The urban thermal environment has an important impact on human health and sustainable development. Most of the current mainstream studies on the influence of thermal environment focus on the relationship analysis with a single factor, but there are fewer studies on multiple factors and their interactions, and there is a lack of analysis of human activities as an important factor. In this paper, the relationship between summer surface temperature and natural environment, surface cover, landscape structure, and human activities in Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region is investigated in depth by using Bayesian structural equation model. The results show that: impervious surface (0.66) and air temperature (0.78) have significant positive effects on the thermal environment, while vegetation (-0.37) and transpiration (-0.27) have significant negative effects on the thermal environment; human activities indirectly affect the surface thermal environment through their effects on the natural environment and landscape structure, so the construction of the driving mechanism model of the surface thermal environment needs to consider the role of human activities The model results are optimal at 6k scales, with Rhat less than 1.01 for all parameters, Bulk_ESS and Tail_ESS values greater than 1500, and no effect value over 1. The LOOIC value is 67431.1. The remote sensing image data has the advantages of sufficient data volume and significant spatial and temporal effects, so it is feasible and effective to apply it to BSEM analysis.

articleTitle: Deep-Learning-Based Localization Approach with Pseudorange for Pseudolite Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: The pseudolite system can broadcast navigation signals and can be used as a good supplement or substitute to the global navigation satellite systems. The pseudorange measurement is usually used to calculate the initial position. However, the pseudorange positioning is still faced with the multipath problem. To improve the positioning accuracy, a deep-learning localization method is proposed in this paper. The proposed method mainly includes the offline initial phase and the online localization phase. During the offline phase, the pseudorange data is collected and transformed into single-differenced pseudorange. The database is expanded by copying the pseudorange vectors and masking pseudorange values. Then a residual fully connected neural network (ResFCNN) is used to learn the mapping relationship between single-differenced pseudorange and location. A residual connection across fully connected layers is added in the ResFCNN to strengthen the learning ability of neural networks. During the online phase, the trained model and real-time pseudoranges are used to predict the location. Experimental results show that the root-mean-square error (RMSE) of the proposed method is 0.73 m under a multipath condition and 1.21 m with a signal absence, which are reductions in RMSE of 81 and 85%, respectively, compared to the conventional iterative least squares method.

articleTitle: Research on Patent Network Structure of Advanced Materials Industry in the Central Plains Urban Agglomeration
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: As a manifestation of innovation achievements, patent can effectively measure the regional science and technology level, comprehensive innovation capability and competitiveness. The study of cooperation and transfer network of patent achievements in important regional industries is helpful to identify the key links and elements in regional industrial science and technology innovation. Based on the patent application data, cooperation data and transfer data of advanced materials industry in the Central Plains Urban Agglomeration, this paper uses the social network analysis method to construct the patent cooperation topology network, weighted patent cooperation network and transfer network, and analyzes its structure. Based on the above characteristics analysis, we propose suggestions to promote the industry university research collaborative innovation level in the advanced material industry of Central Plains Urban Agglomeration, including structuring a comprehensive science and technology service platform of Central Plains Urban Agglomeration, giving full play to the supporting advantages of Zhengzhou University and building professional science and technology service institutions.

articleTitle: H-infinity Optimal Performance Design of Maglev Control System based on Bode Integral Constraint
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Conventional H-infinity control design methods for maglev control system design cannot acquire the optimum disturbance suppression performance. In the present study, based on the performance requirements of Bode integration, the H-infinity state feedback design was improved and applied to the design of unstable maglev control system. More importantly, the Bode integral limit requirements for system performance were considered to make the designed method more practical. Meanwhile, the design principles for these parameters are provided to avoid the need for repeated debugging. A simulation of a maglev control system showed that the Bode integral cannot only evaluate the system performance, but also guide the control design. For an unstable controlled plant, the H-infinity state feedback control method becomes a complete design scheme that can be used to design a system capable of attaining optimal performance under the robustness constraints of the Bode integral theorem. In addition, the proposed method can also be applied to the design of the control systems of other unstable plant, such as an inverted pendulum.

articleTitle: Spacecraft Close-range Position Tracking Control via System Uncertainty Observer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: In this paper, the nonsingular fast terminal sliding mode control for spacecraft close-range position system is investigated with model uncertainty and external disturbances. First, a system uncertainty linear observer is employed to estimate and compensate for the system uncertainty. Second, based on the nonsingular fast terminal sliding mode surface, the position tracking control law with unmeasured velocity is proposed which not only eliminates the chattering phenomenon but also guarantees the tracking errors of the system converge in finite time. Finally, through the simulation results, the effectiveness of the proposed control law is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Low carbon economic operation optimization method of micro electric network based on adaptive artificial bee colony algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: The distributed new energy in the microgrid group has high uncertainty. There are still a certain proportion of micro gas turbines and fuel cells in the microgrid group, which will produce certain pollutants. This paper studies the optimal regulation method of micro grid group aiming at the economy and environmental protection of micro grid group operation. The established optimization model is solved by using the adaptive artificial bee colony algorithm to realize the adaptive adjustment of the weight of the optimal solution exploration, and fully excavate the optimal control scheme of the micro grid cluster that can meet the economic and environmental protection of the operation of the micro grid cluster.

articleTitle: Research on Active Jamming Recognition Method Based on Fractional Fourier Transform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Compared with traditional jamming, sampling and repeater jamming with more similar echo characteristics are also widely used. Aiming at the problem that radar is difficult to correctly identify jamming and extract useful signals in a complex jamming environment, this paper studies a jamming recognition method based on the Fractional Fourier Transform (FRFT). This method first selects the fractional optimal rotation angle of the radar received signal through angle traversal, obtains the optimal fractional Fourier transform of the received signal, and estimates the signal parameters. Then, the fractional domain characteristic parameters which are easy to calculate and less sensitive to noise are extracted from the fractional domain results of the received signal. At last, we brought the parameters into the decision-making process of jamming recognition and simulated and verified the performance of jamming identification. The experimental results show that the algorithm can accurately identify the typical active jamming of radar.

articleTitle: Auditory-Based Multi-Scale Amplitude-Aware Permutation Entropy as a Measure for Feature Extraction of Ship Radiated Noise
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Feature extraction of ship radiated noise (SRN) plays an important role for target detection and recognition. Aiming at extracting prominent and reliable features of SRN, auditory based multi-scale amplitude-aware permutation entropy (AMAAPE) is proposed in this paper. The proposed method consists of two parts that are signal decomposition and multi-scale entropy quantification. Firstly, a set of filters that can effectively simulate the mask effect and frequency response of human ears is designed, through which the SRN is decomposed into a series of band-limited signals. Then, multi-scale amplitude-aware permutation entropy (MAAPE) is employed to measure the complexity of each band-limited signal. Experimental results show that the proposed scheme achieves higher classification accuracy compared with multi-scale permutation entropy(MPE) and variational mode decomposition (VMD).

articleTitle: Research on The Integrated Application of Blockchain and Traditional Information System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: With the rapid development of blockchain technology, blockchain projects applied to different scenarios are gradually being widely studied and applied, but the parallel development trend of blockchain and traditional information system will exist for a long time. This paper introduces the structure model based on Ethereum and traditional information system integration application, puts forward the implementation method of the two kinds of system integration application, analyzes the possible risks and problems existing in the integration application, and discusses the future development and construction of cross-system technology.

articleTitle: Design of New Media Advertisement Visualization System under Recommendation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: The traditional advertising display method requires a lot of manpower for publicity, the input cost is high, the income is slow, and it is difficult to manage effectively. The purpose of this paper is to study the design of new media advertising visualization system based on recommendation algorithm. First of all, this paper summarizes the working methods of web crawler, elaborates the visualization tools in detail, and discusses the current situation and development of Weibo advertisement recommendation. On this basis, an improved algorithm is proposed. Design and develop a personalized advertising recommendation visualization system based on user interests. The main body of this system is the microblog platform. This paper conducts experiments on the advertisement recommendation algorithm by collecting microblog texts of different users. The results show that when the number of recommended advertisements is 20, the recommendation accuracy of the algorithm proposed in this paper is 93%, which is more accurate than the traditional recommendation algorithm. closer to user interests.

articleTitle: A Blockchain Enabled Federal Domain Generalization Based Architecture for Dependable Medical Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Federated Learning allows data to be trained together as a global model without leaving the local area. However, federated learning still suffers from central server failures and lacks a principle of trustworthiness. At the same time, in medical clinical practice, the federal learning model performs very poorly when generalized to healthcare institutions that do not participate in the common training of the model. Therefore, this paper proposes a trustworthy medical image segmentation architecture based on blockchain-enabled federated domain generalization. Based on federated learning, the reliability of the segmentation model can be improved based on enhanced model generalization by introducing a Fourier-based domain generalization mechanism and blockchain technology. We evaluated the proposed approach with the optic cup and optical disc segmentation task for retinal fundus images. The evaluation results show that the architecture outperforms fundamental federated learning in terms of model generalization and accuracy, while also providing reliability.

articleTitle: A Deadline-Constrained and Cost-Minimized approach for Workflow scheduling in IaaS clouds
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Workflow is widely used to represent and model complex applications of various scientific and business fields. Due to the compute-intensive and communication-intensive character-istics, cloud computing, which can provide a great quantity of resources at short notice, is undoubtedly an ideal deployment environment. In cloud computing, cost and time are two major concerns for workflow scheduling problems. Various algorithms have been devised for this problem; however, they are not satisfactory in terms of generating schedules within acceptable time. In view of this, this paper studies the deadline-constrained and cost-minimized workflow scheduling problem, and proposes a well-designed approach named Resource Integration Workflow Scheduling(RIWS). RIWS consists of four phases: workflow partitioning, deadline distribution, task selection and service selection, which accounts for partitioning tasks into dependency free sets, allocating sub-deadlines for each task, establishing the scheduling order of tasks and assigning services for tasks, respectively. The results demonstrate that, RIWS has higher scheduling success rate and can find less expensive solutions for the testing workflows when compared to two peer approaches.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation and Experimental Study of Hydrodynamic Characteristics Based on Dynamic Programming Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Mike software is a kind of numerical simulation software, which is usually used to analyze environmental problems such as water flow and water quality changes in lakes, rivers, and oceans. The MIKE 21 model includes multiple modules, among which the hydrodynamic simulation module is the core of the MIKE 21 model and is the basis for the simulation of other modules. Aiming at the influencing factors of the artificial lake hydrodynamics, this paper establishes the MIKE 21 hydrodynamic simulation model, and uses the dynamic programming algorithm to analyze the influence of factors such as throughput, wind direction, water level on the hydrodynamic characteristics, and analyzes the distribution characteristics and changes of the artificial lake flow field. rules, thereby helping to regulate and improve lake water conditions. In this paper, the dynamic programming algorithm is used to analyze the numerical simulation results of the water flow field of the artificial lake, and it is obtained that the initial simulation error of the MIKE 21 hydrodynamic model is relatively large.

articleTitle: Target Localization Accuracy Analysis for GNSS_based Multistatic Radar
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Global navigation satellite system (GNSS) _based multistatic radar is explored for target localization in this paper. Since any point on the earth can be illuminated by a minimum of 4 satellites of each GNSS constellation at any time, GNSS_based passive radar can be inherently considered multistatic radars. In this paper, we focus on the target localization accuracy analysis and CRLB is applied to evaluate the localization accuracy. Two situations, target localization with different number of satellites and target with different signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), are performed to analyze the localization accuracy. Simulation results indicate that a higher localization accuracy can be guaranteed with more satellites. Meanwhile, a higher accuracy can be obtained once the variation range of the echo SNR obtained by different satellites is small.

articleTitle: Research on Parallel Solving of the Disturbing Gravity of Missile Trajectory based on Gradient Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: In the outside space of earth, The effect of the disturbing gravitation on the long-range ballistic trajectory and guiding precision can not be ignored. Therefore, In order to insure the precision of the missile, the disturbing gravitation of outside space must be taken into account when we calculate the ballistic trajectories. In the thesis, In order to solve the demand of the information about the effect of the disturbing gravitation on the long-range missile’ s emission in the outside space of earth, we adopt gradient method to solve the disturbing gravity in the outside space. To solve the problem that it costs a lot of time and can not be calculated in time when we compute the disturbing gravity about long-range missile as well as it’ s complex model. We adopt the parallel method of principal and subordinate mode. The result indicates that if we adopt parallel method to solve the disturbing gravity of missile trajectory based on gradient method, we can reach the demand of fast calculating by computer and get a high precision.

Author Keywords: the disturbing gravity of the outside space

articleTitle: Image super-resolution using multi-level high-frequency feature fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Recently, single image super-resolution based on deep convolutional neural networks has made significant progress, but there are still problems such as lacking high-frequency texture details and poor visual quality. As the network depth grows, the loss of high-frequency information becomes more and more serious. In this paper, we propose a method to enhance the high-frequency details by fusing multi-level high-frequency features through skip connection and high-pass filters. In order to enhance the representation of global features, our network structure combines both Transformer and channel attention as the base module. Finally, to further improve the visual perceptual quality, we design a contrast loss using gaussian blurred images as negative samples. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Research on the prediction model of cable-stayed bridge force based on attention mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Bridge health monitoring is mainly for long-term automatic measurement of load, environmental effects and structural response of bridges to provide remote moni-toring, online early warning, condition assessment and decision aid services, but there are few services to determine bridge condition for future development trend. In this paper, we use an attention-based long and short-term memory (LSTM) model for predicting the cable-stayed bridge force, which is nonlinear and non-stationary. In this paper, an at-tention mechanism is added to the LSTM model to predict the future cable force values with good accuracy and low mean square error. The similarity between the predicted and real cable force values reaches 0.97, which indicates that this method can be used to predict the cable force values of cable-stayed bridges. The prediction results are better than the LSTM model and the recurrent neural network (RNN) model.

articleTitle: Cable Tension Measurement System Based on Lora Module
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Considering that the static tension on the cable will change in real-time due to factors such as waves, subsurface currents, and wind loads when the deep-sea anchor towing machine performs towing operations, and the excessive load of the cable will endanger the safety of the towing machine and even the whole ship, and it is necessary to accurately measure the cable. The static tension is monitored and displayed online so that safety measures such as emergency release can be taken at a time when the cable load exceeds the limit. In this paper, the sensor data is sent to the cable tension measurement system through the LoRa wireless network, and the tension data is monitored in real-time, which can avoid cable breakage and ensure safety.

articleTitle: Valve Positioner Opening Control Based on Variable Universe Fuzzy Logic ADRC
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: In view of the high requirements for valve control accuracy and stability in industrial process control, Aiming at the high requirements for valve control accuracy and stability in industrial process control, a valve opening control scheme based on variable universe fuzzy auto disturbance rejection is proposed. Use AMESim and Simulink for joint simulation. First, build the controlled object model in AMESim, and then import the established controlled object model into the Simulink module of the active disturbance rejection control system. The expansion factor is introduced to improve the fuzzy control performance. Through fuzzy control Set the parameters of auto disturbance rejection controller. The simulation results show that the variable universe fuzzy auto-disturbance rejection controller has strong anti-interference ability and good adaptability, can quickly and stably reach the preset control opening, and can achieve precise and stable control of the valve opening.

articleTitle: Research on teaching quality evaluation model of online courses in Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Through the research on the classification of knowledge points of online courses, the current online teaching quality evaluation has some problems, such as unscientific evaluation index weight, imperfect evaluation system and so on, The deep learning model is applied to the research of text and image classification and recognition of online course evaluation indicators. By collecting the latest research results of big data analysis model for teaching quality evaluation of relevant online courses, By mapping big data models to research objectives, Using the analytic hierarchy process to preliminarily determine the weight index. At last, The big data analysis model is proposed to be applied to the online course evaluation system structure and the online course evaluation index system.

articleTitle: Application of Mathematical Models in Forecasting the Usage of Water, Electricity and Gas in Hospital Logistics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: To explore the prediction effect of mathematical models on water, electricity and gas usage in hospital logistics operations, in order to obtain the best prediction model and improve the level of hospital logistics refinement management. Monthly data of water, electricity and gas usage of hospital logistics from January 2016 to December 2020 were selected for the training and testing of the model, a nonlinear self-organizing regression neural network model and an exponential smoothing correlation model were constructed, and the prediction effect was evaluated and analyzed by evaluation indexes. The goodness-of-fit of the NARNN model reached 0.87047 on the training data set of water usage, 0.91166 on the validation set, and 0.94479 on the test set, with an overall model goodness-of-fit value of 0.88075, and an overall goodness-of-fit value of 0.95808, close to 1, in the prediction of gas usage, and the seasonal multiplication model in the water and electricity The RMSEs of the seasonal multiplication model in both water and electricity usage forecasting reached the lowest. All the mathematical models used in this paper can effectively predict the water, electricity and gas usage data. By evaluating the index results, a comprehensive comparison shows that the nonlinear self-organizing neural network model has the best prediction effect and can provide prediction data support for information decision making and energy saving and emission reduction deployment in the hospital logistics department.

articleTitle: Toxic gas detection robot
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: This paper focuses on the hardware platform construction and the mobile terminal software design of the toxic gas detection robot. It is mainly composed of infrared control remote control module, LCD display module and mobile terminal. In the software development and design, the master program is written using Keil, and the signals are measured and monitored through a modular and top-down design. When the MQ-7 carbon monoxide sensor detects an abnormal carbon monoxide signal within a certain period of time, the system transmits the signal to the MCU after processing the signal through the AD0832-centered AD converter. Finally, the carbon monoxide concentration is displayed by the liquid crystal. An alarm is issued immediately when the concentration exceeds the limit, and the data is uploaded to the mobile monitor via the HC-05 Bluetooth module.

articleTitle: An Algorithm of Extracting Signature and Seal of Electric Power Marketing Inspection Documents
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: At present, in the on-site inspection of electric power marketing data, manual inspection is needed to check whether documents conform to specifications, mainly to check whether there is a corresponding seal in the approval area of documents and whether there is a signature of the relevant person in charge. With the traditional technology, the inspectors check documents manually and pick out documents that do not meet the approval standards through visual inspection, which brings heavy workload, low efficiency, and a good chance to make mistakes. To realize automatic inspection, we need to scan printed documents into electronic document image, and extract the signature and seal from the image. However, some documents have both the seal and signature requirements, and the signature and the seal often have overlapping areas. The color of the area is different from the color of the original signature and the color of the seal. Therefore, when the signature and seal are extracted through color recognition, the complete seal outline and signature outline cannot be extracted. Based on this, this paper has proposed an algorithm for identifying signatures and seals, the Overlapping Signature and Seal Extraction Algorithm (OSSEA). When the signature and the seal are present on the document, and the signature and the seal have overlapping areas, the image of signature and the outline of the seal can be completely extracted.

articleTitle: Sea Ice Environmental Load Assessment System Based on Convolution Identification Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: In order to ensure the safety of navigation, it is necessary to ensure the bearing capacity of sea ice when sailing at sea. In order to realize the actual measurement of sea ice level load and evaluate the sea ice load, this paper builds a sea ice environmental load evaluation system, optimizes the performance of the load evaluation system under the convolution layer operation of the convolution identification algorithm, and improves the system evaluation accuracy. This paper compares the system performance before and after the algorithm optimization, and the results show that the system performance after the optimization of the convolution recognition algorithm is better. The load evaluation experiment of the centralized sea ice structure and the distributed sea ice structure in the sea ice environment is carried out by the system. The results show that the load identification accuracy of the centralized sea ice structure is high, and the evaluation parameters of the system are quite ideal.

articleTitle: p-Moment Stability of a class of Stochastic Dynamic Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: In this article, the p-moment stability of neutral stochastic differential dynamic systems with Markovian switching are discussed. A new set of sufficient conditions proving the stability in p-moment of the neutral stochastic dynamic systems with Markovian switching are derived by mean of the the Banach fixed point theorem, some integral inequality and stochastic analysis method. Some well-known results are generalized and improved.

articleTitle: Brain Tissue Data Registration based on Context Demons Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Image registration of brain tissue data has been used in disease diagnosis, surgical navigation, human brain mapping and some other fields for decades. At the present stage, brain image registration process generally adopts nonlinear registration algorithm, among which Demons algorithm is one of the most widely used. Owing to the growing processing requirement of large amount three-dimensional brain tissue data, the calculation burden of registration algorithm should be relieved. In this paper, the distribution of brain image intensities would be limited to a few significant categories by the mean clustering segmentation, which can facilitate the registration speed while ensuring the image registration effect. Then, an adjacent slice context processing configuration is proposed to reduce the redundancy calculation based on the slow spatial variation of brain tissue, and significantly improvement of the convergence rate in the Demons registration can be achieved. Finally, in view of the large tissue differences, an elimination and re-registration procedure is implemented for better accuracy, and a well preparation for the subsequent individual differences (such as lesion, tumor etc.) analysis can be achieved.

articleTitle: Research on Personal Privacy Security Detection Technology for Android Application
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: With the intensive release and implementation of relevant laws, regulations and standards on personal information protection, mobile APP, as the key application carrier and entrance and exit of personal information, has attracted more and more attention from government regulators and the public. In order to improve the accuracy of security detection of personal privacy violation in Android Apps, an APP sensitive privacy behavior detection method based on Frida hook monitoring was proposed. The method calls the system function interface through Frida hook APP to intercept and monitor the access to sensitive privacy data such as external storage, address book, SMS and geographical location, and construct the APP sensitive behavior access list. Combined with the application type, comprehensively analyze the permission list and sensitive behavior list to judge whether the APP has the problem of collecting personal privacy information beyond the scope. By selecting common mobile APPs such as audio-visual, online games and social chat, the verification test is carried out. The personal privacy security detection method can find the violation problems of the notified APP, which has certain practicality.

articleTitle: A Low Profile Wide Band Wide scan Tightly Coupled Dipole Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: A low profile wide band tightly coupled dipole array antenna is presented. By adding shorting posts, the common mode resonance in the band is removed. And the addition of the superstrate and impedance transform structure makes the matching degree much improved. The antenna and the impedance transform structure are printed on FR4 substrate with a relative dielectric constant of 4.4. And the superstrate is arranged above the antenna. The proposed antenna can realize 0.86-4.52GHz scanning voltage standing-wave ratio value < 3 up to 45° in E-plane. The structure is simulated in infinite condition through periodic boundary by Ansys HFSS the size of 65.5mm (height)*23.5mm(width)*33mm(length). The results show stable radiation pattern and great polarization purity (<20dB).

articleTitle: Power Consumption Prediction via Improved Gaussian Mixture Clustering Model for Automatically Clustering
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Power consumption is a very important factor in smart grids for load management process. Forecasting electricity consumption is the first step in dealing with load management. Aiming at the energy consumption prediction of power time series, this paper proposed an energy consumption prediction approach based on improved Gaussian mixture clustering. In this study, Gaussian mixture model clustering is used to group the characteristics of power time series, and the proposed clustering fitness evaluation is used to determine the number of clusters automatically. The results showed the accuracy and efficiency of the model and the ability to compete with current techniques for forecasting electricity consumption based on the use of the mean absolute error (MAE) to measure the accuracy of the prediction, as the model was able to achieve better predicting results.

articleTitle: A Multistage Weight Assessment Model Based on AHP and Entropy Information
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Ecosystem assessment is a very complex problem in the society. There are more factors to resolve the problem. To a regional sustainable development, the health of ecosystem is very important in a city. In this paper, multistage-weight (MSW)model is proposed which have two stages indexes. Because, at different stage or level, there are different information which should been taking into account. To the first stage indexes, the Analytic Hierarchy Process(AHP) is used to compute the weight of these factors. The entropy information is used to compute the weight of the second stage indexes. Through the experiment, the MSW model is more reasonable and has the information of two stages indexes than other methods which only use one stage indexes of aquatic ecosystem health.

articleTitle: Risk assessment of power optical cable network based on Tsallis entropy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: To address the problems that there are many factors affecting the vulnerability of power fiber optic cable network and it is difficult to assess the network risk, this paper proposes a risk assessment method for power fiber optic cable network based on Tsallis entropy. Firstly, the factors affecting the health of fiber optic cable are fully explored, a diagnostic index system for the health of fiber optic cable is constructed, and the health and operation level of fiber optic cable are calculated. The simulation shows that the risk assessment method proposed in this paper can accurately assess the riskiness of the power optical cable network and effectively improve the reliability and stability of the power optical cable network.

articleTitle: Risk Analysis and Preventing Methods of Public Zero Line Wiring on Single Phase Electric Energy Meter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Public zero line wiring on single phase electric energy meter in low voltage three phase four wire of power supply circuit may cause great risk of operating safety and power stealing, disturb power supplying order, lead to complaint and affect electric power enterprise's brand image and service quality. This paper detailed analyzed risks of electric shock, metering fault, fire accident, power stealing and power supplying service caused by public zero-line wiring, and proposed strict preventing methods from technical and monitoring.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Interference of Axle Counting System in Subway
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Axle counting system is an important rail traffic signal equipment, which is widely used in railway and urban rail transit fields. Taking the fault of the axle counting system of Guangzhou Metro Line 18 as an example, this paper analyzes the reasons why the electromagnetic interference of Guangzhou Metro Line 18 during the commissioning of the axle counting and wayside equipment produces “pulse not counting” fault, and finds four types of faults. The cause of the failure and the corresponding solution are proposed. The test results show that the proposed solution can greatly reduce the probability of being disturbed and improve the reliability and availability of the system.

articleTitle: Beam Synthesis for The Radar Communication Integrated System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Beam synthesis is a key technology in the radar communication integrated system. In this paper, phased array radar is used as the beam synthesis hardware basis of the radar communication integration. According to the functional requirements of integration., we set the radar main lobe and the communication main lobe for the integrated pattern; and then we set the direction parameters of the radar main lobe and the communication main lobe according to the requirements of radar detection and communication; and then minimize the peak value for the sidelobe objective. The integrated beam synthesis problem is constructed as a first-order convex optimization problem, and finally the beam synthesis problem is solved using the convex optimization toolbox. Through the simulation of uniform linear array elements, it is proved that when the method is used for beam synthesis design, the integrated system beam has lower side lobes under the condition of realizing radar beam and communication beams, and at the same time realizes the integrated system beam.

articleTitle: Calculation Method of System Adjustable Load Considering Renewable Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: The coordination control strategy of the source-load-energy storage effectively makes use of adjustable resources, which plays an important role in peak cutting, valley filling, renewable energy consumption, energy efficiency improvement, frequency, and voltage regulation, and other aspects. It supports flexible regulation of the power system. In the case of a small load in the wet season, based on the conventional unit commitment and their minimum output, a proposed calculation method takes the minimum adjustable load required for system configuration as the objective function. The renewable energy consumption constraint and the coordination operation strategy of energy storage are considered. The adjustable load satisfying the abandoned power requirement of renewable energy is calculated by analyzing the whole day participation state and proportion of the adjustable load in system regulation. Finally, a regional power grid is used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed calculation method. The calculation results show that the reasonable configuration of adjustable load can reduce the amount of abandoned power.

articleTitle: Single-Event Effects Induced by Heavy Ions in 40nm Resistive Random Access Memory
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: We investigated the heavy ion single-event effect (SEE) susceptibility of 40nm monolithic resistance random access memory (RRAM). The results show that single-event upset (SEU) of the memory cell occurred only in the write operation. The SEU of the cell was caused by the single-event transient (SET) of the peripheral circuit and the selection transistor. The dominant SEE type in dynamic modes was single-event functional interruption (SEFI). Some SEFIs could revert on their own in the next cycle, the rest needed a power cycle. We classified and analyzed all SEFIs into different types according to the number of cycles (or recovery mode) and the address distribution of the error data. Different types of SEFI are caused by SEU in different registers.

articleTitle: The Vulnerability Testing Method and Management for Software Source Code
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Source code security is the foundation of software security, so it is of great significance to test source code defects before the software system goes online. This paper first elaborated the causes of source code security defects, and introduced the identification methods and repair measures of source code vulnerabilities in detail. Finally, it described the testing process management of source code. This paper has a certain practical guiding significance for source code vulnerability testing.

articleTitle: Bidirectional ignition technology controlled by pressure pulse coding for oil and gas well tubing conveyed
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: According to the characteristics of static pressure and dynamic pressure in oil and gas wells, this paper designs and develops a pressure pulse coding control technology, which outputs control signals after the preset pressure signal is consistent with the impulse code pressure formed after pressurization. At the same time, the bidirectional ignition technology is designed by using electronic switch and positive and negative electric technology. With the combination of two technologies. the application of pressure pulse coding control technology form two kinds of pressure codes, positive and negative electric output, as the judgment standard of control output. The two groups of codes correspond to the positive and negative output of bidirectional ignition technology, which can realize clustering ignition and hierarchical control of oil and gas wells. The technology provides a new set of safe and reliable technology for intelligent ignition of oil and gas field, intelligent control of downhole tools, clustering perforation and other professional fields.

articleTitle: A Highly Scalable Music Source Separation Method based on CGAN
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: A considerable part of the research in the field of sound source separation is carried out on the amplitude spectrum. And the technique of separating the sound source on the amplitude spectrum seems to have encountered a bottleneck. In this paper, an audio separation method based on the amplitude spectrum, CMCTW, is proposed, which can well separate the accompaniment and vocals in music, and has better performance and effect than the cutting-edge waveform domain sound source separation algorithm. The model solves the problem of low separation quality by improving the network architecture of CGAN and proposing a loss function corresponding to the network. At the same time, a sigmoid adaptive T-F masking is proposed to improve the quality of the audio generated by the model. In the evaluation of indicators such as SDR, this method is superior to most of the current sound source separation algorithms.

articleTitle: Salient Region Detection Based on Spectral Residual and Sparse Reconstruction Error
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: In this paper, we propose a salient region detection method based on spectral residual and sparse reconstruction error. Spectral residual is obtained in the frequency domain, and very effective in extracting foreground which is relatively more salient than background in an image. Sparse reconstruction error effectively represents the whole image because of considering sparsity. We combine both spectral residual and sparse reconstruction error to successfully detect salient regions in an image. We first choose salient super-pixels obtained by image segmentation by spectral residual, and then compute sparse reconstruction error based on the salient super-pixels. Finally, we generate visual saliency maps by normalizing the visual saliency. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method successfully detects salient regions in an image and outperforms state-of-the-art ones in terms of the average score in subjective evaluations.

articleTitle: FDTD Algorithm for Bistatic RCS Prediction of 3-D Target on two GPUs
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: As a numerical algorithm, the finite-difference time domain (FDTD) is effective in solving electromagnetic scattering problem of medium with high complexity. The computional efficiency is low by the traditional central processing unit (CPU) platform. Therefore, the GPU-based FDTD method used to speed up its computational efficiency for bistatic RCS prediction of 3-D object is realized in this paper. Both the validation and efficiency of our implemen is verified by comparison of parallel result versus CPU's. A speedup of about 38x is realized on two NVIDIA K40 GPUs, which improves the computational efficiency. The results also show that the computional efficiency of the parallel method is related to the number of Yee cells.

articleTitle: Research on Multipoint Data Acquisition System Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: With the development of social economy, Internet of things(IOT) communication technology has been widely used in smart home, industrial control, smart city, smart agriculture and other aspects. This technology also provides a lot of convenience for our daily life.
