In this paper, we designed a multi-point data acquisition system by using embedded system and Internet of things communication technology. It can use the AD converter of embedded system to collect multi-point experimental data in real time, and then send it to the control terminal through the Internet of things, which is convenient for users to view the test data in real time and eliminate the security risks when the system is working, The experimental results show that the multi-point data acquisition system we designed can monitor the changes of multi-point data in real time, and the acquisition system has good stability.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Gestures in Interactive Works
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: In recent years, artworks have received extensive attention due to their unique expressions and conveyed ideas, and interactive artworks have also aroused the interest of the public and researchers. At the same time, with the rapid development of computer science and technology, emerging technologies such as gesture recognition have brought new development directions to interactive artworks. This paper focuses on the application of gesture recognition technology in interactive artworks. By designing a deep learning structure to estimate the 3D hand pose from regular RGB images, the gesture recognition accuracy is maintained while reducing the amount of network parameters, and the gesture recognition network is lightened so that it can be applied to interactive artworks.

articleTitle: Coordinated Allocation of Multi-station Fusion Substation based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: With the structure of the AC/DC hybrid distribution network becoming more and more complex, and the distributed generating units need to be located and fixed, a quasi-radial distribution system with 15 bus is used as the model, and an improved genetic algorithm is proposed to deal with the coordinated allocation of multi-station fusion substation problem in this paper. In this proposed method, the POX crossover method and the domain search mutation method are used. Finally, The proposed method is verified by simulation experiments. Simulation results illustrate the improved genetic algorithm has good performance to solve the problem of DG unit location and capacity.

articleTitle: A Control System of Intelligent Building Air-Conditioning Load in Virtual Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: The virtual power plant brings together all kinds of scattered and adjustable power sources and loads, and forms a virtual “power plant” through digital means for unified management and dispatch, and at the same time participates in the power market as an important role. The air-conditioning load in intelligent buildings is an important adjustable load of the virtual power plant. The adjustment of the air-conditioning load can greatly improve the power load curve, realize peak shaving and valley filling, and avoid excessive power fluctuations of the electricity load in summer. This paper introduces a virtual power plant intelligent building air-conditioning load control system and its control strategy, which maximizes the comfort of air-conditioning service objects while realizing power regulation.

articleTitle: Neural Network Adaptive Contribution Evaluation and Prediction Model of Energy Intensity
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Development of low carbon environmental protection energy becomes requirements, peak in carbon, carbon neutral requirement is raised, extensive international track evaluation index, to evaluate a region cut carbon emission reductions, energy intensity in the whole society as a comprehensive key indicators, both associated with control of the total energy consumption, also related to the benefit of the unit of energy output. This paper proposes a adaptive neural network computing, from the perspective of the connotation of decomposition by multiple elements of social energy intensity contribution model, can be decomposed contribution of various elements on the current energy consumption and to quantify the energy consumption intensity influence key factor prediction, calculation under a given energy intensity target, social economy, efficiency, structure and matching index of growth. Solve the blindness of energy intensity prediction and the matching of policy objectives.

articleTitle: Business Communication Model Recommendation Algorithm of New Media Live Broadcast under Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: The development of science and technology has provided a more convenient live broadcast platform for new media live broadcast. At the same time, with the support of big data technology, the business communication mode of new media live broadcast is more diversified. This paper builds a commercial communication recommendation platform for new media live broadcasts with advertisers, live broadcast platforms (hosts) and users as the main body, and introduces a recommendation algorithm to recommend live broadcast content for users, in order to hope that the live broadcast platform can recommend videos for users according to their preferences, to meet the needs of users for live viewing. After analyzing the algorithm's recommendation accuracy and user satisfaction, it is found that the use of collaborative filtering-based recommendation algorithm is conducive to recommending live videos that conform to their preferences, and provides a path for promoting the sustainable development of the live broadcast industry's business communication model.

articleTitle: Campus Culture Communication System Based on Artificial Intelligence Virtual Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: The campus culture communication system can not only guide people to watch the campus space environment, but also improve the soft power of campus culture from the perspective of image construction and cultural communication. The purpose of this paper is to study the campus cultural communication system based on artificial intelligence virtual technology. First, it discusses the role of artificial intelligence virtual technology on campus cultural communication, and analyzes the development and transformation of traditional media and digital media in the campus cultural communication model. The system design is based on the technology of CAVE stereoscopic display device, Unity3D engine and KinectWrapper.unitypackage plug-in, and uses psychology to test and analyze the influence of CAVE campus culture communication system on campus culture communication. Data analysis shows that increasing the user utilization rate of the campus cultural communication system based on CAVE can bring users more campus information and understand the history of the campus, thereby improving the awareness of campus culture and the understanding of the role of cultural communication.

articleTitle: Knowledge Graph Completion Method Based on Embedding Representation and CNN
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Knowledge graph embedding is to embed entities and relations into a low-dimensional vector space, thereby improving the ability of knowledge representation. Models represented by ConvE combine knowledge graph embedding with convolutional neural networks, but these models still treat each node of the triplet as an independent part, which makes the feature expression ability insufficient. Aiming at the problem of insufficient information interaction ability, a knowledge graph completion model based on embedding representation and convolutional neural network is proposed. By fusing the information of different nodes of the triplet with each other, and forming a vector matrix with the original triplet as the input of the convolutional neural network for feature extraction, the feature expression ability of the triplet is improved. The experimental results show that compared with the ConvE model on the datasets FB15K-237 and WN18RR, the MRR index is increased by 6% and 2.2%, respectively; the Hit@1 index is increased by 12.7% and 0.6%, respectively.

articleTitle: A matching method of manufacturing resource sets for guide roller production equipments
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low searching efficiency of equipment manufacturing resources when the production operation of guide roller is outsourced in the cloud manufacturing environment, this paper proposes a matching method of manufacturing resource sets for guide roller production equipment. Firstly, based on the matter-element model of manufacturing resources of guide roller production equipment, the clustering of manufacturing resources is realized by calculating the comprehensive correlation degree. Then we used the attributes of a resource in the cluster set to complete the matching of the guide roller production equipment manufacturing resource set and the production operation manufacturing demands; Finally, we used the actual production data of guide roller to carry out experimental verification, which proves the effectiveness of the proposed method in the application of guide roller production operation outsourcing.

articleTitle: Large-scale Network Survivability Association Model based on Set Pair Analysis Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: In order to realize the detection of devices in engineering drawings, this paper proposes an engineering drawing recognition method based on the improved YOLOv4 algorithm, which is applied to the detection of component targets under circuit diagrams, while modifying the backbone network of YOLOv4 to MobileNet V3. Traditional drawing auditing is mostly done by manual methods, and with the development of information technology, the application of image technology and With the development of information technology, applying image technology and pattern recognition to drawing audit is a hot application of artificial intelligence in drawing audit. The traditional pattern recognition-based circuit identification method is susceptible to interference, clarity and low robustness. yolo is a simple and uncomplicated algorithm that can make predictions based on the whole picture information, and the learned picture features are more general. In this project, by modifying the backbone network of YOLOv4, the feature extraction capability for different scales is improved; the training is performed using Mosaic data enhancement, and various optimization methods such as cosine annealing algorithm and CIOU are used. The final experiments show that this algorithm maintains a high inference speed compared to the original algorithm, while the mAP reaches 90.60% and the model size does not exceed 54.2 MB, while the correct prediction rate of a single image on Raspberry Pi reaches 96.4%, which is in line with the expected situation.

articleTitle: Extraction of Buddha Elements from Thangka Images Based on Improved DeepLabV3+
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Nowadays, Thangka as China's intangible cultural heritage has attracted more and more attention. Semantic segmentation of Buddha elements in Thangka images can let the public understand Thangka culture. Using the results of semantic segmentation, the artistic elements in the image can be extracted and recreated as material. This paper constructs the first semantic segmentation dataset of Buddha elements based on Thangka image, and proposes an improved DeepLabV3+ model based on DeepLabV3+ model. Firstly, the lightweight MobileNetV2 is used for feature extraction, and then the asymmetric convolution module is used to replace the dilated convolution in the ASPP block to obtain richer features, and the segmentation accuracy is guaranteed without increasing the calculation time. Finally, the segmentation results are used to extract the Buddha elements in the Thangka image. Experiments show that the improved DeepLabV3+ model proposed in this paper has higher accuracy and less calculation than the original DeepLabV3+ model on the Thangka dataset.

articleTitle: Hull deformation measurement equipment based on LVDT sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: During the process of sailing at sea, the ship is affected by the impact of waves and temperature changes, which will cause slight deformation of the hull structure. Measuring this deformation is very meaningful for understanding the health of the ship. According to the needs of practical projects, this paper designs a device that uses LVDT sensor to measure the deformation of the hull. After the signal returned by the LVDT sensor is conditioned by the AD698 chip, it enters the controller through the signal conditioning part and the A/D conversion part. After the data is packaged in the controller, it is sent to the host computer through the field bus, which realizes all functions from parameter measurement to data transmission. Considering that in the actual use process, the internal temperature of the hull may change greatly in a short period of time, the position and parameters of the key capacitors are specially designed in the circuit design stage. In addition, this paper also designs a calibration instrument that can measure the sensitivity and linearity of the equipment, and tests the hull deformation measuring equipment under fixed temperature and changing temperature respectively. The experimental data proves that the equipment has similar working characteristics under the condition of 30°C~50°C, the linearity can reach 0.269%, and it can be competent for the measurement of the deformation of the hull structure.

articleTitle: Chaotic Characteristics Analysis on Aerostat RCS via Phase Space Reconstruction and Largest Lyapunov Exponent
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: This paper qualitatively and quantitatively analyzes the chaotic characteristics of radar cross section (RCS) time series concerning an aerostat. First, the phase space of aerostat RCS time series is reconstructed via the time delay processing. And the corresponding optimal delay time as well as the optimal embedding dimension are determined with the C-C method. Then, the small data sets method is utilized to get the largest Lyapunov exponent of aerostat RCS time series. Finally, a case study on aerostat RCS time series is carried out. The results show that regular chaotic attractors exist in the reconstructed phase space, and the calculated largest Lyapunov exponent is larger than zero, thus demonstrating that the aero tat RCS time series has chaotic characteristics.

articleTitle: Traffic Light Timing Optimization based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Intersections are one of the important factors affecting the overall traffic efficiency of road sections. To alleviate the pressure on road traffic and improve the traffic efficiency of intersections, this paper proposes an optimization model of signal light timing from three aspects of road, vehicle and environment, selects road capacity, average delay and vehicle carbon emissions as optimization goals. In addition, this paper proposes an improved particle swarm optimization to solve the model. Add adaptive weights to the particle swarm optimization, update the particle position by levy flight to improve the ability of the algorithm. The experimental results show that the timing scheme obtained by using the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is superior to other methods in terms of convergence speed and convergence accuracy, which proves the feasibility and superiority of the algorithm.

articleTitle: The study of retinal vessel segmentation based on improved U-net algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Fundus retinal vascular images are an important basis for clinical diagnosis and prevention of many diseases. Due to the complex structure of retinal vessels and the resistance to differentiation from the image background, it results in poor retinal vessel segmentation. In order to improve the accuracy and efficiency of fundus retinal image segmentation, the paper added multi-scale convolutional kernels based on the U-net network structure. This structure can extract the image feature information of different layers and fully learn the features of retinal images; and the residual network structure is added to prevent the problem of gradient disappearance and explosion when the network level deepens. Experiments show that the model proposed in this paper can effectively obtain multi-level feature information of images and improve the effect of retinal image segmentation. The accuracy of this algorithm in DRIVE dataset achieves 97.45% and 82.56% sensitivity.

articleTitle: Frontiers of Chinese entrepreneurship education research based on data visualization analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: In order to visualize the current frontiers of entrepreneurship education research in China, we selected 1196 relevant research literatures in the last 20 years from CNKI database, and used CiteSpace tool and clustering algorithm to analyze the authors and research institutions. It includes visual analysis of cooperation network map of author cooperation, innovation and entrepreneurship research institution, keyword co-occurrence map and keyword cluster map. In addition, we also discussed and analyzed the three stages of China's entrepreneurship education research. The results show that the current frontiers of entrepreneurship education research in China is integration and new engineering teaching, which helps to intuitively understand the frontiers of entrepreneurship education research in China.

articleTitle: Simulation for Balancing of Assembly Line using Heuristics: A Case Study of Automotive Manufacturing Industry
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: The efficiency of production is greatly determined by the assembly line's balance. It entails an even distribution of work among all workstations in order to ensure a smooth flow of work with minimal bottlenecks. The Kilbridge and Wester Column (KWC) is a heuristic approach that is often used in line balancing. The balancing of assembly line of an automotive industry that manufactures the air condition duct ASSY of a car is focused in this study. The Problem reported by management is an unequal allocation of job load across employees resulting in a high ideal time. The assembly line is optimized by using the Kilbridge and Wester Column approach. To test and verify the results, the present and proposed models are simulated using arena software.

articleTitle: A fusional positioning scheme based on 5G for substation operation safety control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Accurate location information is very important for substation operation safety control. This paper proposes a seamless indoor and outdoor positioning technology that integrates Beidou and UWB technologies. The Beidou satellite positioning technology is used for positioning in outdoor environments, and the positioning mode is switched to Beidou and UWB at the junction of indoor and outdoor environments, and to UWB positioning mode when entering indoor environments. By increasing the threshold mechanism, the power consumption and computation waste caused by the repeated switching of the indoor and outdoor positioning system are effectively avoided, and the seamless connection of the fusion multi-positioning technology is realized. In order to realize Beidou +UWB joint positioning, we proposed a unified calculation method of coordinate system and time system. Through comparative simulation, the fusion positioning scheme has higher positioning accuracy than Beidou or UWB positioning alone.

articleTitle: An ensemble approach to predict local lymph-node metastasis in cancer based on SMOTE strategy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Local lymph node metastasis is a standard mode of tumor metastasis. Accurate prediction of local lymph node metastasis in cancer patients can help select appropriate treat-ment. Long non-coding RNA (LncRNA) has been proved to play an essential role in cancer prediction. According to the characteristics of such data, problems such as data imbal-ance, high dimensionality, and small sample size may arise in the analysis involved. Besides, considering a large amount of adequate information in LncRNA expression profiles and the correlation between different features, the commonly used data dimensionality reduction method may not retain the expression profile information well. In this research, taking complete account of data imbalance, a comprehensive feature extraction method is proposed by combining an ensemble classification strategy with Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE). The biometric selection and linear discriminant analysis were used to reduce the feature dimension and enhance computational complexity. Some comparative experiments were conducted on three tissue-specific cancer datasets, and the performance validated the effectiveness of the VotMeta in terms of accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on life prediction method of DWT-AR airborne equipment based on $\text{DSP}+\text{FPGA}$ architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Aiming at the problems of poor real-time performance and low efficiency of airborne equipment life prediction, a DWT-AR life prediction implementation method based on DSP+FPGA architecture is proposed. Firstly, the discrete wavelet transform is used to extract the time-frequency domain features of the sensor data, and the feature vector is constructed, and then the AR model is used to realize the life prediction of the airborne equipment. The PHM platform based on the DSP+FPGA heterogeneous computing architecture realizes the embedded computing based on the DWT-AR life prediction algorithm, which provides a solution to the accelerated computing problem of the airborne equipment life prediction algorithm. The experimental results show that this platform achieves a 6.58-fold increase in the accelerated computing efficiency of airborne equipment life prediction, while the power consumption is only 28.9% of that of the PC platform.

articleTitle: The architecture design and application of IP SDN controller system
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: In the era of SDN/NFV technology, in order to meet the goal of cloud network convergence and cloud digital transformation, this paper proposes an IP SDN controller architecture design and implementation scheme. According to the characteristics of loose coupling and flexible deployment of each module, the system architecture of IP SDN controller is designed to realize the decoupling of four layers: application layer, service abstraction layer, core network function layer and protocol adaptation layer. In addition, as a common module, the plug-in development platform of the controller provides the micro-service governance, plug-in framework, continuous integration and continuous delivery tool chain involved in the above four layers. Through key capability research and development, deployment and implementation verification and technical standardization, IP SDN controller, as the core capability base of a new generation of cloud network operation system, enables cloud network integration.

articleTitle: Efficiency Study of SSAG on RNN Framework
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: SGD (Stochastic gradient descent) is widely used in deep learning, however SGD cannot get linear convergence and is not effective in large amounts of data. This paper use SSAG to improve the efficiency. SSAG contains two optimization strategies, one is stratified sampling strategy and the other is historical gradient averaging strategy. It has the advantages of fast convergence of variance, flexible application to big data, and easy work in deep network. This paper studies the efficiency of SSAG gradient optimization algorithm based on RNN framework. The proposed RNN framework comprises a feature extraction layer, a stacked RNN layer, and a transcription layer. The experimental results confirm that the accuracy of SSAG is better than the SGD and the Momentum. Both stratified sampling and historical averaging strategies have the effect of improving task accuracy. Experimental results verified that SSAG has better effect in image classification task.

articleTitle: Valve-controlled asymmetric cylinder position model reference adaptive control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Aiming at a series of problems existing in asymmetric cylinder system controlled by symmetric slide valve, such as asymmetric positive and negative dynamic performance, low precision, poor stability, large lag, strong nonlinear, model reference adaptive control is adopted to make the output of the controlled system track the ideal output of the reference model. In this paper, the mathematical model of valve-controlled asymmetric cylinder is established and the appropriate reference model is selected according to its mathematical model. Finally, by MATLAB/SIMULINK simulation, compared with the classical PID control, this method can achieve more accurate symmetric control and position control.

articleTitle: Research on the Factors Influencing Consumer Behavior Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: In the era of big data, big data has reshaped consumer behavior. It influences consumption behavior not only from the external consumption mode, but also from the internal consumption psychology and other factors. Big data plays different roles in online and offline consumption. This paper combines big data with consumer behavior through SOR model, establishes a consumer behavior model in big data environment, and verifies it according to actual investigation. The results show that the stimulus of external factors to big data affects consumer behavior through intermediary factors (internal perception). Therefore, we should strengthen consumption governance in the era of big data by improving the database, providing rich products, and ensuring information security.

articleTitle: Research on Construction Error Metrology of Hull Ship Blocks Using Large-scale Scanning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Construction error measurement of hull ship block is nontrivial at the stage of block assembly. Traditional way which relies on single-point measurement device is time-consuming. In this paper, an algorithm for the construction error acquisition of ship blocks is proposed, which is based on point set registration between the real scanned point cloud and the designed model of ship blocks. A rigid registration based on Gaussian Mixture Models is employed to match the images obtained by different scanning stations. Then, approximate distance metric for the distance from an arbitrary point to the implicit model is adopted. The construction error is represented as the deviation of the actual positions. The experimental results show that our proposed method is adaptable to the large-scale point cloud with high occlusion, noise and outliers.

articleTitle: Comparison of aerial target recognition methods based on ISAR imagery
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: With the development of science and technology, target recognition has become a hot spot in the field of pattern recognition. In the military field, accurate identification of enemy targets is an important prerequisite for winning in high-tech warfare, and aerial target recognition is one of the typical applications, where higher recognition rates are particularly important due to the greater mobility and flexibility of aerial targets. This paper focuses on finding classifier algorithms with higher recognition rates by comparing the recognition effects of different classifiers on ISAR imaging data of aerial targets.

articleTitle: 5G Communication Technology Application in Active Distribution Network Protection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: With the high proportion access of distributed power supply, the traditional three-stage current protection has been difficult to adapt to the increasingly complex fault patterns of distribution network. Limited by the communication level of distribution network, multi-terminal protection is difficult to be popularized and applied in distribution network. The characteristics of large bandwidth, low delay and high reliability of 5G communication provide a new communication mode for protection service of distribution network. In this paper, the characteristics of low delay and high reliability of 5G communication technology are considered to achieve accurate fault location and isolation, improve the protection level of distribution network and power supply reliability. The research results of this paper can provide a useful reference for the application of 5G communication in the field of relay protection of distribution network.

articleTitle: An Attribute Extraction Algorithm based on Canny
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Edge detection of images is a technique to extract information about changes in image properties, which is a hot topic in the field of image research and a prerequisite for image processing and computer vision. Image edges are the set of those pixels in an image that have a step change or roof-like change in the gray scale of surrounding pixels, and contain the most critical information in an image. And fast and efficient extraction of image edge information is crucial to the whole process of image processing. In order to improve the accuracy of acquisition in edge image information processing and eliminate the interference effects of edge burrs and shadow parts, this paper performs image edge extraction based on the Canny edge detection operator, and then fits a curve to the extracted contours by the Halcon correlation operator and derives the contour correlation properties. It is proved that this study helps to improve the extraction accuracy of subpixel edge image contour information and promotes the subsequent image processing.

articleTitle: Medical Big Data Statistical Management System Based on Decision Tree Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: In some hospitals, it is often seen that because there are more patients and fewer doctors, the attending doctor often rushes between the patient's wards to query the patient's physiological data, or the nurse is responsible for recording the patient's physiological data and reporting it to the doctor. The work is very labor-intensive, and the data seen by the doctor is not real-time data, so the judgment of the patient's condition is not real-time and effective. To this end, this paper develops a medical big data statistical management system, which collects, counts, and stores patients' medical information in the system's management database for centralized management and facilitates query. For the storage of medical big data(BD), this paper uses a distributed cache framework to store medical data information, and implements distributed data processing through the C4.5 algorithm of the decision tree(DT) algorithm. The experimental results of large-scale(LC) medical data processing based on the C4.5 algorithm are also The data processing efficiency of the algorithm is illustrated, which provides great convenience for medical data management.

articleTitle: Service-based cloud platform application monitoring analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Aiming at the problem of insufficient ability to collect and analyze exceptions in the whole process of application performance monitoring methods in cloud platforms, a cloud platform-based method is proposed. Application Anomaly Detection and Bottleneck Identification System for Service Components, which provides customizable metrics for applications on multi-tier cloud platforms Value monitoring and analysis capabilities. The system first collects cloud platform service call data at the front-end application service layer and associates it with abnormal events;A customized anomaly detection method is configured to achieve the optimal detection effect; finally, performance anomalies caused by non-workload changes are identified and bottlenecks are identified. The experimental results show that the monitoring system can quickly and accurately detect different types of abnormal events and identify performance bottlenecks, which can meet the performance requirements of applications under the cloud platform. Ability to monitor demand.

articleTitle: Direct Torque Control for Switched reluctance motor With Multi-level Hysteresis Controller
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: This paper aims at the problem of large torque ripple caused by hysteresis controller of switched reluctance motor in traditional direct torque control. In order to reduce the torque ripple, a multi-level hysteresis controller based on direct torque control is proposed. By analyzing the basic principle of switched reluctance motor, the torque hysteresis is divided into three levels by using a multi-level control method. While ensuring the rapid response of system torque increase and decrease, it can effectively reduce torque ripple. In this paper, the duty cycle is discretized, and vectors with different amplitudes and phases are used as control vectors, extending the traditional direct torque control switch table. The simulation results show that the control algorithm can effectively reduce the torque ripple.

articleTitle: Named Entity Recognition in Qu Tan temple murals based on BERT-BiLSTM-CRF
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: In this paper, the named entity recognition (NER) technology is applied to the field of Qu Tan temple murals to identify religious entities in the text. In order to obtain a machine-readable corpus, the relevant books are scanned and optical character recognition is performed, and then the data is manually labeled to form the named entity recognition dataset needed in this study. In this paper, the bidirectional encoder representations from transformers (BERT) model is used to encode the input data, and the obtained word vector can effectively extract the features of the text by making use of the relationship between words. In order to obtain more accurate context information, the bidirectional long short term memory (BiLSTM) is used to extract features and output the prediction label corresponding to each word. After the BiLSTM model, the conditional random field (CRF) algorithm is joined, which will correct the score of the output, and the output is the optimal label sequence. In this study, the performance of the model is also improved by data enhancement.

articleTitle: Accuracy study of energy-saving control for parallel pump systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: This study evaluates the prediction accuracy as well as model suitability of three performance models for parallel variabe-speed pumps using test datasets under various conditions. First, theoretical models of parallel pumping set were built for subsequent calculations. Then, the ordinary least squares (OLS) method was used to acquire the best regression coefficients of each model. After that, the operation datasets of the pump were tested by field measurement under varied conditions, which were compared with the calculated values of different models, and the relative errors were analyzed to seek the model with better accuracy and suitability. The results of this study would provide reference for selecting performance models for the energy-saving optimization of parallel pump systems and strategic development of optimal operating control.

articleTitle: An ANN-based soft-sensor to estimate the sand content of drilling fluid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Drilling fluid is an essential fluid in drilling work, various performance parameters of the drilling fluid directly affect the drilling efficiency and the life of the drilling equipment. In order to ensure the efficient and safe drilling process, in view of the difficulty of real-time monitoring of sand content in drilling fluids, this paper proposes an online data-driven sensor based on artificial neural network (ANN) to estimate the sand content of drilling fluid. Two artificial neural network prediction models are established, one is based on the drilling fluid viscosity, and the other is based on the Herschel-Balkeley model. The models are analyzed from the aspects of practicability and accuracy. The simulation results show that the neural network models trained by the LM algorithm can effectively predict the sand content of the drilling fluid.

articleTitle: The Design Innovation of Shop Floor Paradigm Towards Smart Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: The integration and application of science and technology, such as big data, cloud computing, the internet of things, deep learning, 5G, and digital twin in the manufactory industry, makes smart manufacturing come true. The smart shop floor is the foundation of smart manufacturing. However, the construction of a smart shop floor is a multi-disciplinary system. The focus problems of equipment management, after-sale service, and data collection are summarized. To get a detailed requirement analysis, the specified needs from customer leadership, device manager, electric engineer, and maintenance staff were collected individually. Due to the nature of this study, from the case enterprises' viewpoint, the common requirements and challenges were collected and illustrated. According to the connotation of a smart shop floor, it provides an integrated starting point toward a more systematic realization of the smart shop floor paradigm to adopt smart manufacturing.

articleTitle: Fast power line detection based on semantic flow
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: In this paper, a Semantic-flow-based fully convolutional network model (SFCN) is proposed to solve the problems of low recall rate in the extraction of thin and long transmission lines in UAV images and are easily affected by complex background and illumination. The backbone of the model network adopts a smaller number of channels to reduce the number of parameters and speed up the learning speed. The inverted residual module is used to enhance the feature learning ability of the network under low number of channels and to prevent model degradation. The semantic flow module replaces the skip connection to complete the accurate fusion of high-dimensional features and low-dimensional features, and finally outputs the pixel-by-pixel recognition results. The method in this paper can realize quickly power line detection. Compared with the regular semantic segmentation models ENet, UNet, NestedUnet, DeepLabv3_plus, GCN, SegFormer, FCHarDNet, BiSeNetv2, and DDRNet, the method in this paper performs the best, with an F1 value of 83.693% and a recall rate of 80.64%.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Automation Technology based on Low-voltage Intelligent Switch
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: With the continuous progress of social economy, the shortage of electric power is becoming increasingly severe. At this time, the development of smart grids is extremely important. At present, permanent fixed equipment is used for online monitoring and load control of each main power supply terminal. However, the dedicated power quality monitoring and load control equipment is very cost-effective and has limited monitoring effects. In order to study a method that can reduce power loss and improve the efficiency of distribution network automation, at the same time, in response to the needs of the construction and development of smart distribution networks, a distribution network automation technology based on low-voltage smart switches is proposed. In the experiment, the relevant content of the low-voltage smart switch is introduced, and the mathematical model is established during the analysis of the distribution network automation technology. At the same time, the changes of the supply voltage deviation, voltage fluctuation and flicker, and three-phase voltage unbalance are numerically calculated.. The design principles and performance of low- voltage distribution switches are explained in the design of the system, so as to analyze the importance and feasibility of distribution network automation technology based on low- voltage smart switches in the field of distribution network technology. The experimental results show that the distribution network automation technology based on low- voltage smart switches can reduce the maximum interruption time, the minimum interruption interval time, and the total interruption time of each load by nearly 10%, which improves the utilization rate of electricity.

articleTitle: Efficient Feature Enhancement for Few-Shot Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: The neural network has exhibited strong performance in various machine learning tasks, but deep neural network model will deteriorate rapidly when the amount of data is insufficient. Few-shot object detection aims to detect unseen objects under little supervision scenarios. Attention RPN uses support images to enhance the query image, enabling RPN to generate support-relevant bounding boxes and to detect novel categories without fine-tuning. In this paper, We propose a more powerful approach to enhance query feature. Firstly, we explored approaches to generate convolutional kernels containing support information and selected the more useful ones. Then, as the Attention RPN does not take into account the correlation between channels, we added the channel attention associated with the support feature to the query feature to further improve the detection of the model. To verify the effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper, we conducted experiments on the benchmarks and showed good results.

articleTitle: Design of Dual-core Collaborative Computing Gateway for Geological Hazards
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: The previous gateway for monitoring geological hazards often focuses on receiving and transmitting data, which means sending the data stream from sensor terminals to the cloud server as much as possible. However, with the increase in the types and number of sensor terminals in geological hazard monitoring sites, such a massive data transmission mode cannot meet the needs of monitoring geological hazards. Therefore, a dual-core collaborative computing gateway for geological hazards is developed. Based on the previous network topology of monitoring geological hazards, a collaborative computing method of MCU and 4G Cat1 communication module is designed to transmit the real-time data stream received by MCU to the 4G Cat1 module, realizing complex calculations, such as mathematical model implementation and data early warning. In addition, this method can reduce the data traffic from the device to the cloud server and relieve the pressure on the server's data processing. The experimental results show that compared with the previous geological hazards monitoring gateway, the data transmission volume is reduced by about 81%, and the power consumption of the gateway using Raspberry Pi 3B is reduced by about 30.6%.

articleTitle: Research on electric vehicle load Optimal Access Point based on Grid operation risk assessment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: With the development of energy consumption towards green environmental protection, more and more EV charging loads will be connected to the power grid. Due to the randomness and fluctuation of new energy output such as wind power and photovoltaic power and electric vehicle charging load in modern distribution network, frequent overload of power grid and other risks affecting its safe and stable operation may be caused. Therefore, on the basis of constructing the probability density model of new energy output and the mathematical model of EV load charging, combining Metropolis sampling method and sequential Monte Carlo method, this paper proposes a calculation method of EV load optimal access point based on grid operation risk assessment. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified with IEEE33 node system.

articleTitle: Research on the causes of false positives in source code detection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Source code is an important part of information system. With the rapid development of Internet, there are more and more information systems, and the work of source code detection is also increasing. At present, the work of source code detection usually depends on automatic inspection tools, but automatic tools bring convenience and some false positives. Therefore, this paper studies the causes of false positives in the process of source code detection, and puts forward several methods to reduce the false positives rate of source code detection. The methods improve the efficiency and quality of source code detection effectively.

articleTitle: Predictive Dynamic Scheduling Approach for Heterogeneous Resource Pool
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: In recent years, heterogeneous resource pools play an increasingly important role in high-performance computing. There are some challenges for the existing scheduling algorithms due to the increasing complexity of jobs submitted by users on the heterogeneous resource pools. This paper proposed a heterogeneous GPU cluster scheduling approach based on predicting job resource usage to obtain the optimal scheduling strategy, which constructs a prediction model based on the operation of the classified jobs on each heterogeneous chip. The core of the approach is to predict the computing usage characteristics of each job over a period and deploy them to appropriate nodes, when new jobs are waiting in the resource pool. The scalability and utilization of the resource pool are significantly improved, especially in the complex and heterogeneous GPU cluster environment. In addition, the approach is capable of decoupling and separating the jobs and scheduling them in parallel. Experimental results show the execution efficiency of the system is dramatically increased.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Cloud-Based Auxiliary Transaction Decision-making Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: With the development of China's economy and the continuous increase of national income, more and more retail investors are devoted to stock management, but they lack professional knowledge and skills, so it is difficult for them to make profitable trading decisions. In addition, the distribution of resources in China is uneven, the quality and service level of financial institutions are restricted by regions, and there is a big gap between the service levels of financial institutions in different regions. To effectively solve this problem, a cloud computing-based open and shared auxiliary transaction decision-making platform for multi-tenant and multi-organization is proposed and constructed. Let the investment and wealth management services of financial institutions with high quality and service level be able to cover underdeveloped areas. At the same time,to better personalize the recommendation for users, and satisfy the user's ability to quickly screen financial institutions that meet their own requirements from a large number of financial institutions, a Slope One algorithm that improves the calculation method of project similarity is proposed. Considering the user's project on the basis of scoring, the final similarity is calculated by integrating item attributes, news attributes and time factors. This method can effectively improve the recommendation accuracy and solve the cold start problem to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Prediction and Analysis of Energy Saving Potential for Fuel Cell Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: The energy-saving potential analysis of fuel cell vehicles has become a current research hotspot. In this paper, the theoretical analysis of fuel cell vehicle modeling is carried out, and then the typical fuel cell vehicle is modeled. Quantitatively analyze the factors affecting vehicle energy consumption, and analyze the influence degree of hydrogen consumption on curb weight, fuel cell system efficiency, and motor efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Vibration Measurement Technology and Safety Evaluation Method of Outdoor Isolating Switch
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: In view of the obvious wind-induced vibration of the pillar switchgear in the windy area, which makes the switch opening and closing operation difficult, and brings security risks and other problems. This paper through the research of non-contact vibration measurement technology, long-distance, non-contact vibration measurement has been realized, which provides vibration measurement technology, means and tools for the operation and maintenance management department. Combined with the vibration characteristics of each position of the pillar switchgear obtained from the vibration measurement, the paper established a simplified model, which is used to analyze its amplitude offset and force characteristics. The obtained results are carried out evaluation analysis with the mechanical properties and limits of each component, and giving warning prompts for parts that exceed the range, and risk prompts are also given for components with large vibration offsets, and give suggestions such as installation of damping devices.

articleTitle: The Research on VPN Route Control Mechanism with Route Distinguisher Granularity in Intra-AS and Inter-AS Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Virtual Private Network (VPN) is widely used in intranet communication of customer sites in different Autonomous Systems (AS). The existing VPN route control mechanisms cannot filter VPN routes with Route Distinguisher (RD) granularity. This paper defines a RD-based routing control mechanism-VPN Prefix Outbound Route Filter (ORF) mechanism. The encoding format of VPN Prefix ORF entry is given, including the length and meaning of every field. The trigger of this mechanism on the sender of VPN Prefix ORF entry is described in detail to ensure that normal VRF will not be influenced due to the rejection of some VPN routes. Besides, this paper describes the operation processes of VPN Prefix ORF in inter-AS option B/AB/C scenario, intra-AS scenario and VPN routes shared on one PE scenario.

articleTitle: Tomography Technology of GIS Basin Insulator Based on Laser Ultrasonic
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: GIS is widely used in high voltage transmission and transformation system due to its small area and good insulation performance. As an important component of GIS, basin insulators play the role of supporting conductors, isolating gas chambers and electrical insulation. If there are cracks, bubbles and other defects in the basin insulator, partial discharge will be caused, which seriously threatens the safe and stable operation of the equipment. In order to conveniently and timely detect the cracks and bubbles of basin insulator, the GIS imaging method enhanced by laser focused ultrasound is proposed. This method can not only detect defects but also image, providing intuitive image information for power grid operation and maintenance personnel.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Space Constrained Message Middleware in Cyber Physical Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: As the carrier of interactive messages between objects in smart city cyber physical systems(CPS), middleware is the basis for realizing the interaction and collaboration of smart city CPS. Most of the existing middleware are limited by the space scope of the message subscriber or publisher, and need to perform filtering and matching operations on the subscriber, which increases the message delivery overhead. Based on the above situation, this paper proposes the middleware model called Ib MQ. Through testing, the results show that the model enables both publishers and subscribers to have the ability of spatial scope constraints, and provides more accurate data interaction capabilities for smart city CPS objects under the constraints of spatial scope, and at the same time verifies the publishing/Selective forwarding of events in subscription middleware is possible.

articleTitle: Control Analysis of Distribution Network Engineering Investment Balance Rate based on Variation Coefficient Method and Grey Relational Evaluation Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: The project investment balance rate is an important control indicator in the process of distribution network project cost management. The investment balance rate can truly reflect the effectiveness of project cost management and the scientificity of project cost preparation. In order to further analyze and control the cost of distribution network projects and effectively improve the applicability of the balance rate index to distribution network projects, this paper innovatively introduces the coefficient of variation and grey relational evaluation model, constructs an index system of factors affecting the balance rate, from the perspective of each sub-project cost of the project, and takes the 10kV overhead line project as an example to calculate the investment balance rate index, analyzes the reasons for the high investment balance rate, and proposes targeted management improvements.

articleTitle: Optimization of laser odometry based on the mulls-ICP algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: To solve the problem that the low accuracy and the excessive drift in large distance of the laser odometry of the three-dimensional laser SLAM (simulta-neous localization and mapping) algorithm, the point cloud matching adopts the multi-metric linear least square ICP (mulls-ICP) algorithm. Firstly, the ground segmentation is realized based on the dual-threshold ground filter, then the fusion of IMU and RTK based on error state Kalman filter (ESKF) provides accurate initial value for point cloud matching, Finally, the laser odometry is optimized based on the multi-metric linear least squares ICP algorithm. The experimental results based on the standard datasets KITTI and MVSEC datasets show that compared with the classic A-LOAM and LIO-SAM algorithms, the proposed algorithm has higher positioning accuracy and better mapping effect. Compared with LIO-SAM algorithm, the error is reduced by fifty to sixty percent.

Author Keywords: multi-metric linear least square ICP algorithm

articleTitle: Fully automatic water-saving irrigation system
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: The fully automatic water-saving irrigation system is divided into two parts: hardware and software. The hardware part includes ESP8266 Nodemcu development board, soil moisture sensor and display components. The soil moisture sensor transmits the detected signal to the ESP8266 chip, which converts it into a digital quantity and compares it with the upper and lower humidity limits set by the internal program to determine whether there is a lack of water, and then controls the relay to drive the pump for irrigation. The display shows the current humidity value, the irrigation mode and the upper and lower humidity limits in real time. The programming software of the software part is Arduino IDE software, using C language to write code program to control the hardware part of the work. the soil humidity received by the ESP8266 chip is transmitted to Ali cloud life IOT platform and cloud smartphone terminal by WIFI transmission, displaying the current humidity and storing data to show the change of humidity in a graph.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Web Socket-based Monitoring Module for Cloud Broadcasting Management System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Cloud broadcasting changes the traditional TV broadcasting mode and will be used on a large scale in the future. Cloud broadcasting management system is to unify the cloud-based TV broadcasting platform and OB equipment. In order to solve the problem of real-time monitoring and control of new OB Vans equipment and cloud-based broadcasting platform in this management system, a real-time monitoring system including device, server and user is implemented based on WebSocket protocol, which solves the problem of pushing messages between users of management system and each OB and platform equipment. This paper expatiates the overall structure of the scheme, designs and realizes the functions of each module.

articleTitle: Media Personalized Recommendation System Based on Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: With information overload, a new feature of the Internet, a large amount of irrelevant, useless and redundant information on Weibo seriously interferes with people's accurate selection of required information. Users need to accurately and quickly obtain the marketing content they need through the media personalized recommendation system. This paper designs a media personalized recommendation system based on network algorithm, discusses the functional requirements of media personalized recommendation and the classification of personalized recommendation system based on network algorithm. Through the experimental test of the media personalized recommendation system, taking Weibo as an example, the data ratio between the number of effective recommendations and several users in each category is tested. The test results show that the correspondence rate between the information recommendation results and user interests of the personalized recommendation system studied in this paper is 79.7%, which indicates that the interest analysis of the user model of the media personalized recommendation system designed in this paper is more accurate. The validity of the algorithm is verified.

articleTitle: The application of three-dimensional information technology in the construction of overhead transmission lines
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: In order to ensure that 3D technology is used as a method and information technology is used as <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{a}$</tex> means of communication to promote the controllability of on-site safety and quality, improve construction management and technical level, and improve construction efficiency and benefits, the 3D geographic information obtained by oblique photography is used. Equivalent model Component import, design a GIM technology that can meet the requirements of tension calculation of wireline operation control gear, real-time calculation of wire pay-off tension, verification of envelope angle, and upward verification through three-dimensional technology. It has been proved by practice that the algorithm and 3D technology are reliable and immediate, and can simulate different operating conditions and operating environments of the power grid.

articleTitle: An intelligent recommendation system and method for industrial Internet platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: In recent years, with the rise of the industrial Internet, more and more industrial Internet platforms have gradually emerged. The large amount of information on the industrial Internet platform makes it difficult for users to query relevant information that suits them. This is the information overload problem of the platform. The recommendation system is an effective method to effectively solve the information overload. This paper proposes a recommendation system for the industrial Internet platform, and designs a recommendation system and method for the industrial Internet platform based on convolutional neural network and attention mechanism combined with factorization machine. At the same time, it also solves the pain points of different importance of a certain product or information to different enterprise users according to the characteristics of the industrial Internet platform.

articleTitle: A Privacy Protection based Countermeasure for E-commerce Price Discrimination
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Price discrimination is a pricing strategy of differentiated prices for different customers usually employed by the provider of goods or services to obtain excess profits. Its essence is a monopolistic pricing behavior. In this paper, we propose a price discrimination countermeasure based on the Randomized Response (RR) mechanism of Local Differential Privacy (LDP). First, we select shopping records of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$N$</tex> customers from the database of the e-commerce platform as a large set P, and then add noise to randomly selected shopping records of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$K$</tex> customers. Due to the randomness, the merchant cannot deduce the shopping record of the customer from the randomized output, thereby protecting the shopping information of the customer. In addition, we use data desensitization technology to project the sensitive personal information of customers. The scheme evaluating results show that the scheme can help customers fight against the price discrimination well.

articleTitle: Research and application of data-driven intelligent traffic law enforcement system
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: With the rapid development of the transportation industry, starting from the goal of improving industry governance capabilities, it is urgent to realize a new model of digital law enforcement with the help of information management platforms and intelligent technological means. This paper analyzes the urgency of carrying out intelligent law enforcement and its pain points based on the characteristics and difficulties of current transportation law enforcement. The law enforcement knowledge base model formed by the transformation of various data such as law enforcement procedures, research and propose a data-driven intelligent law enforcement system, design the overall framework, core modules, etc., and verify the effect through application in the transportation industry, in order to achieve deep intelligence Law enforcement and intelligent supervision provide important support.

articleTitle: Modeling of Production Loss for Assembly Systems during the Warming-period considering Bernoulli Machines and Finite Buffers
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: Production loss characterizes the difference between the expected horizon and the actual system performance. In this paper, an analytical method is proposed to model the production loss for assembly systems during the warming-period considering Bernoulli machines and finite buffers. First, the modeling of the assembly system is performed based on the transient analysis. Second, dynamic states of machines and buffers are formulated to characterize the production loss for assembly systems. At last, the impact of system layouts, machine reliabilities, and buffer capacities on production loss are numerically investigated in case studies. The results indicate that this method can evaluate the production loss for assembly systems during the warming-period, which exhibits the potential to design or manage more complex assembly systems.

articleTitle: Intelligent Water Pressure Sensor for Smart Fire Fighting Water Cyber Physical System Feature Extraction Model Training and Testing Data Acquisition
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: In order to train and test the feature extraction model of smart fire fighting water cyber physical system, it is necessary to collect the pressure data of water supply network. Intelligent water pressure sensor for smart fire fighting water cyber physical system feature extraction model training and testing data acquisition is designed in this paper. The sensor hardware is mainly composed of pressure transmitter, mainboard, battery and shell. The mainboard is mainly composed of processing module and communication module. The pressure transmitter realizes the analog pressure information collection and input into the main board. The main board processing module digitizes the input pressure information based on multi-point linear quantization algorithm. The experimental results show that the accuracy deviation of the designed sensor is less than 1%. The sensor technology supports smart fire fighting water cyber physical system closed-loop control model training.

articleTitle: An improved product quantization method applying fuzzy clustering
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: With the development of computer vision as well as retrieval technology, content-based image retrieval (CBIR) has been widely used. The product quantization retrieval algorithm (Product Quantization) is one kind of CBIR, which contains three steps: Cartesian integral solution of the original vector space, quantization of the lowdimensional vector space, and similarity search. The original product quantization method uses k-means clustering algorithm for quantization of low-dimensional vector space, which will be influenced by the initial point setting to reach local optimum and cause quantization error. Moreover, the features of many pictures are mediated, and the k-means algorithm for the clustering of feature vectors belongs to the hardening score, which will produce a large classification error. To address the above problems, this paper proposes to apply the improved product quantization method of fuzzy clustering (Fuzzy Product Quantization) and tests the effects of different quantization parameters on retrieval accuracy. The quantization of the low-dimensional vector space by using fuzzy clustering avoids the quantization error caused by hardening scores and makes the classification more objective. The use of weighted asymmetric distance calculation in a similar search step can further reduce the error of distance calculation and improve the accuracy of image retrieval. Experimental tests using the Oxford Building dataset show that the retrieval accuracy of the original product quantization method is 61.8% when taking the first 20 images in the retrieval results, and the retrieval accuracy of the proposed method is 64.8%, with an overall accuracy improvement of 3%, and the algorithm performance is better than the original product quantization method.

articleTitle: A Real-time Thermal Compensation Method for a MEMS Accelerometer Based on SRU Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: MEMS inertial sensors have become more and more popular in recent years due to their low-cost, small size and low power consumption, and have been widely used in various fields, but they have the disadvantage of being very sensitive to temperature changes (thermal drift). We propose a real-time thermal compensation method for a MEMS accelerometer to provide an online compensation strategy to mitigate temperature effects in this paper. First, this study uses an in-house-designed Guidance Navigation and Control Module (GNC Module) for temperature effect testing, and the output of the accelerometer is collected during the test. Second, the real-time compensation model based on the accelerometer output at the previous moment is proposed. And then, the false nearest neighbor algorithm is introduced to determine the number of neurons in the hidden layer of the neural network. At last, a recently popular Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) variant, the Simple Recurrent Unit (SRU-RNN), is used to process the MEMS accelerometer raw outputs. With temperature calibration, the thermal drift of the MEMS accelerometer is significantly improved, which undoubtedly proves the effectiveness of the employed method in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Time Synchronization of Improved Clock Servo System Based on PTP Protocol
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: The time offset correction mechanism based on the traditional clock servo system cannot meet the requirements of the IEC61588 protocol for time synchronization accuracy. Due to most algorithms based on optimizing time offset use precise control of time stamps, PI controllers, etc., the optimization effect of the algorithm is low. For the above problems, this paper proposes an improved clock servo system based on the PTP protocol to optimize the time offset, and uses the Kalman filter to ensure the time accuracy of the master-slave clock. Combined with the Kalman filter, the multi-model PI control optimisation algorithm is proposed on the basis of the traditional PI controller to improve system stability by adding a threshold limiting method. Finally, the general master-slave hierarchical topology of the PTP system is built using the OMNeT++ simulation platform to verify the correctness of the improved clock servo system. The time offset of the master-slave clock is less than 10us, which further proves the superiority of the servo system in this paper.

articleTitle: A Novel Ultra-Wideband Matching Load of Substrate Integrated Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC )
abstract: The paper proposed a novel ultra-wideband matching load of substrate integrated waveguide (SIW). The proposed structure is implemented via mature printed circuit board techniques, while resistive film is employed to consume undesired electromagnetic energies traveling through the structure. Benefits from the planar structure, the matching load are easy for fabricate and have a low cost behavior, it is also good at integration with other planar circuits and have a relatively compact size, which is valuable for miniaturized high density microwave circuits. Electromagnetic simulations are employed to analyze and optimize the shape and dimensions of the structure, while the simulation results shown that the proposed structure has a good RF performance among the whole X band. Return losses of the matching load is better than 18 dB from 8 GHz to 12 GHz, while the whole dimension is not greater than 18 mm ×5.5 mm × 0.7 mm, realized on a four layer stack PCB.
